d: British comedian and actor Russell Brand has been handed a 10-year-and-six-month prison sentence after being found guilty of rape and three counts of sexual assault involving four women between 2004 and 2009. At Southwark Crown Court, Judge Joel Bennathan delivered a strongly worded sentencing order, describing Brand as a sexual predator and condemning his dismissive attitude towards consent.
